title: ELEC0055 Elements of Power Electronics, slides Part I (Ch 1-5, 13, 19) and Part III (Ch 6), based on Erickson & Maksimovic

method: bundle (Part I pp1-252, Part III pp253-374)

Slides, not prose; the slides are Erickson's instructor slides hosted publicly by a university course page (verify licence is acceptable).
